title: Cue sheet
description: Timecoded phrases and a compact waveform share a playhead that follows every selected word.
useCase: Review a voiceover through its words while retaining surrounding sentence context and precise time position.
interaction: Play the silent timing preview, select a word or sentence timestamp, or scrub the waveform
reducedMotion: Removes decorative color transitions; word/time correspondence and user-requested playback remain available without scrolling or positional text animation.
limitations: Silent, authored timing with a decorative waveform. Integrations must provide actual alignment data and audio amplitude information; the waveform does not represent a real recording. Host pause and document hiding suspend playback.
look: Sage-grey page with an off-white card of large serif transcript lines, small monospace timestamps, one lime-highlighted word and a dark green waveform transport bar.
motion: Playing advances a playhead across a bar waveform, filling bars lime, while a lime highlight steps word by word through the transcript and passed words darken over 150 ms.
adapt: Timing is precomputed in `STARTS` from `WORDS` (split from `LINES`), with `DURATION` and `ROW_STARTS`; a `requestAnimationFrame` `tick` advances `time` and `index` picks the current word. Replace them with real alignment data, drive `time` from your audio element and use real amplitudes for the bars.
